seoTitle: Sitemap URL Extractor: get every URL from XML sitemaps
seoDescription: Extract all page URLs from a website's XML sitemap with lastmod, priority and hreflang data. Follows sitemap indexes and .gz files. $0.0002 per URL.

url-extracted.eventDescription: One page URL extracted from a sitemap, with its lastmod, changefreq, priority, hreflang alternates and image count. Sitemaps that cannot be found or loaded are not charged.
